comparison.objective: Pick four parts from two conveyor lanes before separate deadlines.
comparison.physical_skill: Prioritize and intercept moving objects based on time-to-loss, then transfer directly to a bin.
comparison.success_condition: Each cube lies still in the bin before passing under its cover and without being staged elsewhere; full credit requires all four.
comparison.reason: Deadline scheduling and moving-object pick-and-place differ materially from stationary coaxial tooling, controlled fracture, and fragment recovery.
